cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Can You Keep It?
cards.instruction: Use increasingly sensitive details to test whether someone deserves deeper trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've tapped the crossed-out bell; I've done mine too. No messages getting out. I withdrew my college application; have you told Mum?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That only mutes alerts. No; I told Mum my sister's plans were hers to explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quiet alerts, yes. I've leased a bakery. Can I send you the address?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum uses my tablet. Call me instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, details by phone. It's Mum's old bakery. Be there when I tell her.

reason: Make copied alert control a false security assumption; B demonstrated discretion and channel correction earn deeper disclosure without replacing strong original arc.
